changelog: Fix: the v3.14.3 diagnostic settled the real cause on the next real paste -- line 19 was a bare 'USDT', clean ASCII, no invisible character at all. Both v3.14.2's NBSP theory and the whole stray-codepoint investigation were chasing something that was never there. Real cause: in the browser copy, a value and its unit can land on separate lines (Fee / -3.86690000 / USDT as three lines, not Fee / -3.86690000 USDT as two); the orphaned unit line survived as an unrecognized leftover and collided with the genuine exit reason. parsePositionHistory() now folds a bare unit token (USDT, or the position's own asset symbol -- plain uppercase letters, nothing else on the line) into the preceding label's value when it lands on its own line. Applied to every label's value, not just Fee -- a second real paste showed only Exit Price splits in that sample while Fee stays inline, confirming Bitfunded doesn't apply this consistently field to field

Verify, no change needed: a winning trade's Realized PnL can carry a leading + (+3.75199USDT) -- bf_parse_num()'s existing strip regex already removes + along with every other non-numeric character, confirmed empirically against the real value

Fix: BitfundedImportController::matchAll()'s exact-match query compared pnl=? -- Bitfunded reports pnl at up to 4 decimal places, this account's existing 59 rows were hand-transcribed from screenshots at 2, so every historical row would have failed to match and been re-imported as a duplicate 'new' row instead of a 'matched' update. Changed to ABS(pnl - ?) <= 0.01 (PNL_MATCH_TOLERANCE), well inside the at-most-half-a-cent rounding gap and far from the dollars-wide gap between genuinely distinct trades that entry_price (kept exact) and the time window already rule out. A real import will therefore refine challenge 6's stored pnl/net_pnl to Bitfunded's true precision -- post-import SUM(pnl)/SUM(net_pnl) will differ slightly from the -120.08/-258.1909 figures on file, a correction, not a regression

Test: bitfunded_parser.php's self-test rebuilt from a byte-for-byte real four-position paste (BNBUSDT, ZECUSDT, LITUSDT, TRXUSDT), replacing the v3.14.1 two-position fixture that had every field's unit inline and had passed every self-test run since while the live path kept failing on real pastes. New fixture asserts all ten fields on all four rows, including the split Exit Price, the leading-+ PnL, and a Short position with a 'Manual Closing' exit reason. 56 assertions pass
